explanation: It fires only at D1, when that D1 shows the first loss after a run of two or more rewarded trials: usually 10 from about trial 55 onward, about 0-5 before trial 45, and now and then 0 even late in the episode. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at rewarded D1s (rarely 1-6), and at a loss that follows another loss.
